item.title: Version 0.11.7
item.description:
Version 0.11.7

Folding and unfolding a project keeps the selection's glass and the pinned projects' box in place, and both fade or resize with the fold. The sidebar's pin sits beside the +, as in Shepherd Mini, and the fold arrow stays inside the pinned box. In the browser, pages that don't fit go into a "more" menu listing every page, and the toolbar's globe is green while the browser is open.

Version 0.11.6

The selected tab, file or change now glides in Liquid Glass: in the sidebar, in Shepherd Mini's list and in the project panel's Files, Search, Commands and Git. Idle tabs say Idle in the sidebar, as in Shepherd Mini. The pinned projects' box keeps the last row's selection inside it, and no longer stretches over the next project.

Version 0.11.5

ShepherdUI's floating tabs no longer cut off the project's name at the top. Closing the last tab of the project you're in now closes it and takes you to another project, instead of opening a new tab in its place.

Version 0.11.4

Fixes across the app: the browser and Shepherd Mini no longer send keys to a terminal you can't see, Mini's shortcuts and Git branch list work inside it, the bubble's card stays on screen, Discard can no longer empty a renamed file, the update settings show their real values, and per-file undo in the editor.

Version 0.11.3

ShepherdUI: a darker frame in dark mode. The project tabs that float over the terminal now sit inset from its edges, with rounder corners, a shadow and clearer glass.

Version 0.11.2

Compact is now ShepherdUI, a look native to Shepherd. Its sidebar and project panel are Shepherd's own, so they join the toolbar in one frame on macOS Tahoe too, and they glide open and shut with the sidebar button and Run travelling along. ShepherdUI opens with the full sidebar, its toolbar holds still in full screen when the window buttons slide in, and the sidebar's filter and New Tab stay clear of the projects scrolling under them. The browser searches with Google by default (Settings › Terminal › Browser › Search with), and you can sign in to Google there.

Version 0.11.1

In the Compact layout, a project's floating tabs no longer flicker when the pointer rests on the window's edge, and they get out of the way when you resize the window.

Version 0.11.0

A browser beside your terminal: page tabs, an address bar that takes a port (3000), desktop layout by default, phone, tablet and Mac sizes with rotation (⇧⌘M), a console of the page's logs, errors and failed requests, Inspect Element, and Send to Agent, which pastes a screenshot and the page's errors into Claude Code or Codex. Terminals spot the address a dev server prints: open it from the tab's header, or let Run open it. The divider snaps at half, 65 % and three quarters. In Shepherd Mini the globe (⇧⌘B) shows the browser too.

Version 0.10.5

Shepherd on iPhone can now list every project and its terminals, even with no agent running, and show any terminal's screen (view only). Needs the next iPhone update.

Version 0.10.4

Projects you pin to the top now show first in Shepherd on iPhone too (with the next iPhone update).

item.description: Fixes the Shepherd Mini opacity slider in Settings › Terminal, which couldn't be dragged.

item.title: Version 0.9.3
item.description: Choose how see-through Shepherd Mini is: Settings › Terminal › Shepherd Mini › Opacity, from 40% to 100%, with a preview over your own wallpaper. An open Shepherd Mini changes as you drag the slider.

item.title: Version 0.9.2
item.description: Shepherd Mini can now go anywhere on your screen: drag it by its header, its title or the bar at the bottom of the tab list, and it opens where you left it next time (right-click that bar to move it back under the menu bar). Its name now shows at the top.

item.title: Version 0.9.1
item.description: Shepherd Mini (the drop-down terminal) can now split: Split Right (⌘\), Split Down (⇧⌘\) and Close Pane, beside the tab header or from a right-click, and a click gives a pane the keyboard. Splits are shared with the main window. Its shortcut is now ⌥⇧Space, since ⌥Space also opened the ChatGPT and Codex launcher (change it in Settings › Terminal). Shepherd Mini stays open when you switch Spaces, for example to a full-screen app and back.

item.title: Version 0.9.0
item.description: Shepherd's terminal from any app: press ⌥Space (or click a session) and your tabs drop down over your IDE, with every project's tabs on the left. Replies sent from the menu bar now stay in view. Choose the menu bar icon's colour (Normal, Sage or Blue) in Settings › General. Two Codex sessions in one folder are no longer mixed up. Fixes across the Git page (no lost files on Discard, # lines kept in commit messages), iPhone sync, the shell integration and more.

item.title: Version 0.8.0
item.description: Shepherd has a new look: the Terminal Lens icon and a sage green theme, a new intro where the lamb wakes up behind the lens, and a welcome page about working from the menu bar. Settings has a new General tab with Light, Dark or System appearance. Everyone sees the intro and welcome once after updating.

item.title: Version 0.7.6
item.description: The app icons have new names: Sudo Sheep (the default), Grep Sheep, Ewenix and Dolly (the original two sheep). If you used the default icon, you now get Sudo Sheep, and the Dock shows it right away.

item.title: Version 0.7.5
item.description: A new app icon, Lambda: a >_ whose cursor is a little lamb. Pick Ramdisk, Ewenix or the original Flock in Settings › Agents › App Icon. Shepherd's notification sound plays again (macOS was playing its default ding instead).

item.title: Version 0.7.4
item.description: A third app icon, Ewenix: the sheep with the >_ on its fleece, over soft sage grass. Baash and Ewenix get a deeper dark-mode tile. Settings › Agents › App Icon.

item.title: Version 0.7.3
item.description: Baash, the alternate app icon, now sits at the same size as every other icon in the Dock, with the system's dark tile in dark mode.

item.title: Version 0.7.2
item.description: Choose the app icon: Shepherd's own, or Baash, one big sheep grazing on the grass with a >_ (Settings › Agents › App Icon). It shows in the Dock while Shepherd is open.

item.title: Version 0.7.1
item.description:
Drop files on a terminal to copy them into its current folder, or hold Option while dropping to type their paths (handy for handing an agent a screenshot).

Drop files on a folder in the Files panel to copy them in. Nothing is ever replaced: a name that's taken gets a number, as in Finder.

item.title: Version 0.7.0
item.description: Your iPhone now connects straight to this Mac on the same network: updates are instant, answers land at once, and whole conversations load on the phone. Encrypted with a key only your devices have; iCloud is still used elsewhere.

item.title: Version 0.6.6
item.description: Needs You now shows an orange alert bubble everywhere. Notifications play Shepherd's own sound, with a Sound setting (Shepherd, System Default or None) and a play button in Settings › Agents.

item.title: Version 0.6.5
item.description:
Drag a project up or down the sidebar by its name to reorder your projects: a line shows where it will land.

Clicking an empty part of the sidebar no longer turns the selected tab blue; your terminal keeps the keyboard.

item.title: Version 0.6.4
item.description:
Answer your agents' questions from iPhone: when Claude Code or Codex asks you to choose, the phone shows the question with its options (pick one or several, or write your own answer) instead of Approve and Deny, which only picked the first option for you. Claude's question waits for your phone while you're away from the Mac, and moves back to the terminal as soon as you use the Mac.

Codex started with Start Agent now stays connected to Shepherd, so its approvals and questions show up, with the effort you picked.

item.title: Version 0.6.3
item.description: Coloured file icons and project logos, like VS Code. A clearer working spinner. Shepherd now checks for updates every hour, so the update button turns up soon after a release. The iPhone app groups sessions by project, with each project's name and icon from the Mac.

item.title: Version 0.6.2
item.description: Fixes the iPhone link: turning Share with iPhone off and on no longer breaks it.

item.title: Version 0.6.1
item.description: An update button: when a new version is out, a blue arrow appears beside Settings at the bottom of the sidebar; press it to update. Also a fresh look at the welcome and intro for everyone.

item.title: Version 0.6.0
item.description: A fresh start: a new welcome and a first-launch intro where the icon comes alive. Codex sessions now show when they need you, and you can approve them from the menu bar or your iPhone. Agents a session spawns are listed under it while they work (Settings › Agents › Spawned Agents). The Git page's Commit button turns into Push once you've committed. Plus many fixes: saving keeps a file's encoding, paths with [ ] or # work, and the sidebar's + no longer moves on hover.

item.title: Version 0.5.1
item.description:
Fixes the app freezing while agents work: git work runs in the background, and busy repositories no longer set off a pile of refreshes. Big files edit smoothly.

Much lower CPU use: the working spinner costs almost nothing now, and the desktop sheep rests when it's covered.

If Shepherd ever stops responding, it now saves a report to ~/Library/Logs/Shepherd.

item.title: Version 0.5.0
item.description:
Git page: switch and create branches (local and remote) from the branch menu, and a commit graph like VS Code's.

Shepherd's notifications show its icon in dark mode again.

item.title: Version 0.4.2
item.description: Fixes Shepherd freezing after a while: background Git checks could get stuck and stop the app from updating.

item.title: Version 0.4.1
item.description:
"By LynkSphere" credits in Settings and the About window.

Renaming a tab now renames its session in the menu bar, notifications and on your iPhone.

The desktop sheep now matches the app icon: a blue glass fleece in light mode, white in dark.

item.title: Version 0.4.0
item.description:
Git page: see what changed, stage files, view diffs and commit, right from the project panel.

Start Claude Code or Codex from any tab, picking the model and reasoning effort.

Desktop sheep: Shepherd's sheep floats on your desktop and shows how your agents are doing. Click it to jump to the one that needs you.

Fixed: a new tab could show the previous tab's terminal, and terminal text didn't switch between light and dark mode.

A quieter sidebar, a raised-hand icon in the menu bar, and Files marks new files with U.

item.title: Version 0.3.1
item.description:
Shepherd now shows only the agents running in its own tabs, in the menu bar, notifications and on iPhone.

Reply from the menu bar: hover a finished or working session and click the reply button to answer it, or queue a message while it works.

Notifications end with the start of the agent's latest reply.

On iPhone you can queue messages while an agent works, and see them until the agent picks them up.

The project panel's Files, Search and Commands switcher and its filter fields are tidier, the panel has a single show/hide button, and Settings keeps one size on every tab.

item.title: Version 0.3.0
item.description:
Start sessions from Shepherd on iPhone: turn on Settings → iPhone → Let iPhone start sessions, then pick Claude Code or Codex, a project and a prompt on the phone. The Mac opens a tab in that project and starts the agent.

The iPhone app shows each session as a conversation, with the newest message last.

Codex sessions are listed only while they're running; finished threads no longer linger.

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
A welcome window on first launch walks through the menu bar, your agents, notifications, a first project and Shepherd on iPhone (Help → Welcome to Shepherd shows it again).

The window header is tidier: the folder path shows once, in the tab header, following your terminal.

Notifications are asked for in the welcome window instead of at launch.

item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description:
First release of Shepherd: a menu bar dashboard and terminal for Claude Code and Codex.

See what every agent is doing, get told when one finishes or needs you, and jump to its terminal in one click.

Terminal window with projects, tabs, split panes, files, search, saved commands and a code editor.

Updates itself: Shepherd → Check for Updates…
